page.overview:
Who is Javier Cortez?

Javier Cortez has no current appearance whatsoever. He was only described to wear a clown suit, with a red nose and a wig while haunting others.

Javier was said to be a young and depressed teenager. He enjoys psychologically traumatizing strangers in their dreams, and even getting clown clothes and makeup to scare them more. He was seemingly narcissistic as he would talk about himself in people's dreams, thinking they wouldn't remember anything after they wake up.

Javier wields an unnamed Wound that allows him to enter people's dreams. He uses this to haunt them and provoke them into killing others.
